text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Helios Labs dedicated bring-up next week. Need final quota allocation, autoscale guardrails, and a planned load test window. Renewal meeting in 3 weeks so we want a smooth go-live. Who can own quota sizing?
sam_ops: I can take quota sizing. can you paste expected qps and payload profile?
maria_cs: Thx. baseline steady-state ~60 qps, expected bursts up to 350 qps for 2–5m, avg payload ~800 bytes, long-tail gen requests up to 3k tokens. They use embeddings heavily for search (peaks during day).
zach_eng: For bursts we'll want a fast scale path + cached prefix warmup. Suggest target autoscale metric = 95p response latency < 300ms and GPU util < 85%. Set cooldowns: scale-up 30s, scale-down 5m.
kevin_cs: Also they need KMS audit for private deployment — that might add ~20ms to cold path. flagging with security.
devin_sre: Re: load test — recommend two phases: (1) shadow traffic replay (24h) to warm KV cache; (2) stepped soak with 10m rungs up to 400 qps. Ops checklist + runbook attached in comments.
maria_cs: can we run shadow on dedicated pool or we risk hitting prod?
opsbot: shadow-run created: job/hel-labs-shadow-2026-07-12 (ETA 3h).
sam_ops: Shadow on dedicated pool only, yes. We'll throttle origins and tag traffic. Need client to provide 72h of sampled real traffic or synthetic pattern.
zach_eng: For the stepped soak I'll add a canary policy: first 2 GPUs in pool get traffic, validate latency + error rate < 0.1%. then open to pool. If errors spike, fallback to hosted v2 model variant (lower mem) automatically.
kevin_cs: Renewal risk: finance wants cost estimate per 100M tokens with and without KV caching (they care about $ delta). I'll prepare numbers after quota set.
maria_cs: timeline: quota review by Fri 10AM PT, load test Wed 14th, go-live Fri 16th. Is that feasible?
sam_ops: quota review ok. I'll post proposed numbers by Thu EOD.
devin_sre: load test Wed works but need oncall for the afternoon (14:00-18:00). Putting @dev-oncall on pager.
zach_eng: quick note — when you run the stress script, use this wrk invocation to get representative tail:
```
wrk -t12 -c400 -d10m --latency http://dedicated-pool/helios/v1/gen
```
Tune -c to match concurrent requests during burst.
maria_cs: saw a flake last time where autoscale didn't kick until 90s in. logs: "scale-controller: missing metric shards -> delay". Any root cause?
devin_sre: that was an aggregator lag under heavy foam events. fixed in patch 2026.06.02 but we'll verify in shadow run.
sam_ops: for quotas proposal: Reserve 8 GPUs initially (N1 = 8), burst buffer +4 for autoscale. If traffic grows we can expand by 4. Cost est w/ caching: $X/100M tokens, w/o: $X*1.6. (I'll post exact dollar values in doc.)
kevin_cs: Also note customer requires 30-day audit logs retention for usage and KMS ops — ops will enable longer retention on this pool.
zach_eng: test plan: pre-run health checks, seed KV cache with top prefixes, run shadow 24h, then 3-stage soak (50qps / 200qps / 400qps). Collect 99/95/50p latencies, GPU util, token/sec, and model error counts.
maria_cs: action items: @sam_ops quota draft by Thu EOD, @zach_eng add canary + fallback config PR, @devin_sre schedule oncall for Wed, @kevin_cs cost numbers & audit note. I'll send customer update after quota review.
kevin_cs: ack. I'll also ask finance to expedite renewal packet given timeline.
sam_ops: posting draft now: https://redwood.internal/drive/hel-quotas-v1 (comment on numbers pls) :thumbsup:
opsbot: deploy/bastion reported: no incidents scheduled during Wed 14:00-18:00 window.
maria_cs: perfect — thanks everyone. small ask: include a tiny prompt set for regressions during soak (5 prompts that historically show quality variance).
zach_eng: added prompt set to the PR.
devin_sre: i'll kick off shadow once we have the 72h sample from client. ping me when uploaded.
maria_cs: will collect sample today and update thread. thanks! :rocket:
